calls.prompt:
Create one native RGBA transparent PNG combat sprite sheet for the existing Relay Chronicles character Richard Jenkins, Mass Effect 1. This is a controlled extension of an existing prototype, not a redesign.
REFERENCE 1 is crew-atlas.png: use ONLY the fourth/top-right human male (Jenkins) at pixel rectangle [1152,0,384,512]. Preserve this exact character's helmeted Alliance recruit silhouette: closed dark grey combat helmet with an open visible lower face, pale adult male face, dark charcoal and slate Alliance starter armor with steel-grey panels, black articulated undersuit, gloves and heavy boots. Keep the original muted small shoulder accent. He is NOT Commander Shepard: absolutely no N7 marks, no red/white Shepard stripe, no blue powers, no alien details. Keep helmet on in all four states; do not expose a different hairstyle or replace him with Kaidan.
REFERENCE 2 is companion-ashley-combat.png: match ONLY its crisp pre-rendered HD sprite finish, adult realistic proportions, soft upper-left studio light, grounded scale and three-quarter side view facing screen-right. Do not use Ashley's face, female body, white/pink armor or costume.
OUTPUT exactly FOUR separated full-body drawings of the SAME Jenkins on one 1536x1024 landscape canvas, with truly transparent alpha and no scenery, horizon, floor, shadow pedestal, labels, captions, symbols, cell borders or checkerboard. Every visible limb, glove, rifle barrel and boot must be fully inside its own region with generous clear transparent gaps. Nothing may cross the centre vertical x=768 or the horizontal y=520. Do not add particles, muzzle flashes, rays, debris, extra objects or detached pieces.
UPPER LEFT, within x=70..680 y=45..475: AIM. Jenkins fully standing, planted boots, shouldering his generic dark ME1-style Alliance rifle towards screen-right.
UPPER RIGHT, within x=860..1460 y=45..475: RESERVED TACTICAL GESTURE. Same standing Jenkins, rifle lowered in one hand and free gloved hand briefly signalling a cautious halt. This is only a neutral reserved action drawing, no biotics or omnitool and no new ability.
LOWER LEFT, within x=70..680 y=580..965: HIT. Jenkins reacts to a non-gory impact, knees flexed, torso recoiling and rifle kept close; both boots and every part fully visible. Same helmet, armor and lighting.
LOWER RIGHT, within x=825..1455 y=700..960: DOWN. The same Jenkins lying completely horizontal on his side, helmeted head towards screen-left, boots towards screen-right, rifle held close. This represents a temporary combat KO, not his scripted death: no blood, wounds, death effects or memorial. Use the full wide horizontal space but leave at least 40 transparent pixels around the complete figure.
Keep all three standing/recoiling poses at compatible adult body proportions and the same view. Emphasize clean silhouettes that survive a roughly 110-pixel in-game body height. Keep detailed armor readable without changing its design between states. Preserve native transparency; no baked background.
calls.qualification: Accepted after native RGBA measurement, four separate visible components, eight-pixel frame padding, full-size Chromium source review and 110px CSS frame review. No runtime or exact-original likeness certification.
